How to Play

How it works

  1. Press Play to start a new run.
  2. Open each of the six topics and set your preferences with the sliders and buttons.
  3. Press Next to lock in a topic — a ✓ marks it complete.
  4. When all six topics are complete, press Submit to see your scores.
  5. Balance sustainability, cost and speed — there's no single right answer.
